facts.statement: Aerotitan had an estimated wingspan of at least 5 meters.
facts.quote: A wingspan of at least 5 m has been estimated for this pterosaur.

facts.statement: The only known specimen of Aerotitan is an incomplete snout measuring 264 mm in preserved length.
facts.quote: The only specimen of Aerotitan that has been described is an incomplete snout, which has a preserved length of 264 mm.

facts.statement: The snout of Aerotitan was elongated, transversely compressed, and toothless.
facts.quote: It is elongated and transversely compressed, the jaws being toothless.

facts.statement: The remains of Aerotitan were found in the Allen Formation of the Neuquén Basin in northern Patagonia.
facts.quote: Its only remains, which consist of a partial snout, were found in the Allen Formation of the Neuquén Basin in northern Patagonia.

facts.statement: Aerotitan sudamericanus was named and described in 2012 by Fernando Novas and colleagues.
facts.quote: In 2012, it was made the holotype specimen of the new genus and type species Aerotitan sudamericanus, named and described by paleontologists Fernando Novas, Martin Kundrat, Federico Agnolín, Martin Ezcurra, Per Erik Ahlberg, Marcelo Isasi, Alberto Arriagada and Pablo Chafrat.

facts.statement: Aerotitan fossils were found in Río Negro province, Argentina, in deposits from the Campanian-Maastrichtian of the Late Cretaceous, approximately 70 million years ago.
facts.quote: Los fósiles de Aerotitan fueron hallados en la provincia de Río Negro, Argentina, en depósitos pertenecientes a la Formación Allen, correspondiente al Campaniano-Maastrichtiano del Cretácico Superior (aproximadamente 70 millones de años atrás).

facts.statement: Aerotitan lived during the Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous in what is now Argentina.
facts.quote: Aerotitan is a genus of azhdarchid pterosaur that lived during the Maastrichtian age of the Late Cretaceous period in what is now Argentina.

facts.statement: Evidence of fish, turtle fragments, and elasmosaur plesiosaur remains in the sediment suggests Aerotitan lived in a coastal environment.
facts.quote: Aerotitan fue hallado en sedimentos con presencia de peces indeterminados, fragmentos de tortugas quélidas y restos de plesiosauros elasmosáuridos; esto sugiere que los restos de Aerotitan provienen de un ambiente costero.

facts.statement: Aerotitan was the first pterosaur of the family Azhdarchidae found in South America.
facts.quote: Aerotitan is the first pterosaur belonging the family Azhdarchidae that was found in South America.

facts.statement: It is debated whether Aerotitan belongs to Azhdarchidae or Thalassodromidae, with a 2018 study tentatively placing it in Thalassodromidae but noting the assignment was not well-supported.
facts.quote: However, in 2018, a study published by paleontologist Nicholas Longrich and colleagues classified Aerotitan as a member of the family Thalassodromidae, being the sister taxon of Alanqa (a pterosaur also assigned as an azhdarchid in its initial description). Such assignment is stated as only tentative and is not well-supported.

facts.statement: Within Azhdarchidae, Aerotitan is recovered as the sister taxon of Mistralazhdarcho.
facts.quote: Within Azhdarchidae, it is recovered in the subfamily Azhdarchinae, as the sister taxon of Mistralazhdarcho.

facts.statement: A 2025 study placed Aerotitan in a clade with Zhejiangopterus and Mistralazhdarcho within Azhdarchidae, but outside the subfamilies Azhdarchinae and Quetzalcoatlinae.
facts.quote: Un estudio de Thomas et al. de 2025 recuperó a Aerotitan en un clado compuesto por Zhejiangopterus y Mistralazhdarcho dentro de Azhdarchidae, pero fuera de Azhdarchinae (compuesta únicamente por Azhdarcho) y Quetzalcoatlinae.

facts.statement: The name Aerotitan combines the Greek word for "air" and Titan to allude to the animal's large size.
facts.quote: The generic name combines the Greek word ἀήρ, meaning "air" and Titan, alluding to the pterosaur's large size.

facts.statement: The preserved snout portion is toothless, features longitudinal striations, and is highly vascularized by numerous small pits.
facts.quote: La porción preservada es edéntula (sin dientes), presentando estrías longitudinales y siendo altamente vascularizada por medio de numerosas fosas pequeñas.
